title: What 40,000 Videos Tell Us About The Trending Tab
summary: Coffee Break analyzes about 40,000 videos from seven months of YouTube's trending tab. It examines whether trending is biased toward mainstream media and late-night shows.
why: Cited in threads on YouTube algorithms and creator complaints as a data-driven look at the trending tab.

quote.text: Here's an excellent video breaking down with extremely compelling data how the "trending" tab is very heavily manipulated
